Params.Name: Enabled
Params.Label: Enable Sea
Params.Description: Render the procedural sea surface over the generated terrain.

Sections.Name: WaterLevel
Sections.Label: Water Level
Sections.Description: Controls the sea elevation and how water transitions across the terrain shoreline.

Params.Name: SeaLevel
Params.Label: Sea Level (field units)
Params.Description: Vertical water level in terrain field units. The shader offsets this by the generated terrain height.

Params.Name: ShoreWidth
Params.Label: Shore Width
Params.Description: Base width of the shoreline blending band used for shallow-water color, waves, foam, and alpha.

Params.Name: ShoreSoftness
Params.Label: Shore Softness
Params.Description: Softens and widens shoreline coverage by sampling a larger terrain neighborhood. Higher values make the shore transition gentler.

Params.Name: DeepDepth
Params.Label: Deep Water Depth
Params.Description: Depth scale for transitioning from shallow to deep water and for attenuating shore effects.

Sections.Name: Waves
Sections.Label: Waves
Sections.Description: Controls the layered procedural displacement used to shape the moving water surface.

Params.Name: WaveAmplitude
Params.Label: Wave Amplitude
Params.Description: Height of the procedural waves. Shore-depth attenuation reduces this near shallow water.

Params.Name: WaveLength
Params.Label: Wave Length (terrain scale)
Params.Description: Distance between the main wave cycles in terrain scale. Smaller values create shorter, denser waves.

Params.Name: WaveSpeed
Params.Label: Wave Speed
Params.Description: Rate and direction of wave phase motion. Negative values reverse the motion.

Params.Name: WaveChoppiness
Params.Label: Wave Choppiness
Params.Description: Adds sharper harmonics and stronger gradients to the wave profile, producing more broken or pointed waves.

Sections.Name: SurfaceShading
Sections.Label: Surface Shading
Sections.Description: Controls procedural surface detail, underwater refraction, sky reflection, transparency, and water colors.

Params.Name: NormalStrength
Params.Label: Normal Strength
Params.Description: Strength of the procedural ripple normal perturbation used for lighting, reflection, and refraction.

Params.Name: NormalScale
Params.Label: Normal Scale (terrain UV)
Params.Description: Frequency of procedural surface ripples in terrain UV space. Higher values make finer detail.

Params.Name: RefractionStrength
Params.Label: Refraction
Params.Description: Screen-space offset used to distort the scene visible below the water surface.

Params.Name: ReflectionStrength
Params.Label: Reflection
Params.Description: Strength of the sky/environment reflection. It is visible when sky lighting is available and is Fresnel-weighted.

Params.Name: Opacity
Params.Label: Opacity
Params.Description: Base transparency of the water volume. Foam can remain more opaque than the water body.

Params.Name: ShallowColor
Params.Label: Shallow Color
Params.Description: Water color used near the surface and blended toward the deep color as depth increases.

Params.Name: DeepColor
Params.Label: Deep Color
Params.Description: Water color used at greater depth. Deep Water Depth controls how quickly this color is reached.

Sections.Name: Foam
Sections.Label: Foam
Sections.Description: Controls nearshore breaking foam, offshore ripples, and the animated procedural foam pattern.

Params.Name: FoamStrength
Params.Label: Nearshore Foam
Params.Description: Strength of foam generated around shore contact and breaking wave fronts.

Params.Name: NearshoreFoamWidth
Params.Label: Nearshore Crest Width
Params.Description: Width of the nearshore foam crest. Higher values produce broader, less sharply peaked foam bands.

Params.Name: OffshoreFoamStrength
Params.Label: Offshore Foam
Params.Description: Strength of the subtle ripple foam that appears farther from the shoreline.

Params.Name: FoamScale
Params.Label: Foam Scale (terrain UV)
Params.Description: Frequency of the procedural foam pattern. Higher values create smaller, more detailed foam patches.

Params.Name: FoamSpeed
Params.Label: Foam Speed
Params.Description: Rate and direction of animated foam motion and pulsing. Negative values reverse the motion.

Params.Name: FoamColor
Params.Label: Foam Color
Params.Description: Color blended into the water wherever the procedural foam mask is present.

Buttons.Label: Reload Sea Shaders
Buttons.Description: Reload the sea vertex and fragment shaders after editing shader files.
